newsitem.title: CHINA: China needs to upgrade shipping fleet - industry.
newsitem.headline: China needs to upgrade shipping fleet - industry.

text.p: China, a major buyer of second hand ships, faces growing problems with its fleet as more foreign ports bar sub-standard vessels, industry officials said on Friday.

Many ports are barring sub-standard ships or requiring them to make repairs, they said, adding that more than 100 Chinese vessels were detained in foreign ports last year for required renovations -- up from 34 in 1994.
An international control system was expected to be set up by 2000, the Economic Information Daily said.
"If a world control system is set up, many of our ships will no longer be of any use," said an official of the China Ship Classification Society.
"Some old ships cannot meet international standards and must be repaired," he said without giving further details.
